messages:
mike_platform: Heads up — we need to land a canonical set of GPU metrics for Hosted + Dedicated that Console, quotas, routing and billing can all rely on. Focus: SM occupancy, per-SM memory used, queue depth, per-pool headroom and slot accounting. Proposal below (proto + brief notes). Thoughts? Need owners and a rollout plan. cc @sara_eng @lee_infra

sara_eng: +1. Important we include reserved slots and preemptible slot counts for Dedicated so quotas can be accurate. Also want a 'deployment_mode' tag (hosted/dedicated).

kai_eng_runtime: quick runtime note — sample occupancy at 500ms to capture spikes. KV cache churn affects memory numbers; add kv_cache_bytes. For queue depth we should distinguish waiting vs inflight.

lee_infra: from ingest side: we can accept a v1 proto with these fields, but we need to be explicit about metric types (gauge vs counter), units, and max label cardinality. I'll sketch the ingest contract once we settle names.

mike_platform: proto sketch (draft):

```proto
message GpuPoolMetrics {
  string pool_id = 1; // pool id (coarse)
  string deployment_mode = 2; // "hosted" | "dedicated"
  string region = 3;
  string model_family = 4; // coarse label, max 50 values
  string model_version = 5; // coarse, optional

  // per-SM occupancy percentage (0-100)
  repeated float sm_occupancy_pct = 10;
  // per-SM memory in bytes (including kv cache tag)
  repeated uint64 sm_memory_bytes = 11;
  uint64 kv_cache_bytes = 12;

  // queue depths: waiting and inflight (integer counts)
  uint32 queue_depth_waiting = 20;
  uint32 queue_depth_inflight = 21;

  // headroom in slots/tokens available for immediate allocation
  uint32 pool_headroom_slots = 30;
  uint32 reserved_slots = 31;
  uint32 preemptible_slots = 32;
}
```

mike_platform: Notes: keep labels coarse to avoid cardinality explosion. We want both per-SM arrays and pool-level aggregates (sum/avg).

lee_infra: ingest expectations:
- sm_occupancy_pct => gauge (float)
- sm_memory_bytes => gauge (bytes)
- kv_cache_bytes => gauge (bytes)
- queue_depth_* => gauge (int)
- pool_headroom_slots/reserved/preemptible => gauge (int)
We will add server-side sanity checks for array lengths. Also enforce max distinct (model_family, region, pool_id) cardinality.

metric-bot: Draft schema pushed: https://internal.redwood/schemas/gpu_metrics/v1 (auto-upload) :rocket:

anna_product: Console/UI things: we need per-route and per-model-family drilldowns, ability to compare Hosted vs Dedicated side-by-side, and a small "cost impact" column that multiplies tokens/sec by headroom pressure. Also need a canary toggle so new metrics don't push to prod dashboards until rollout completes.

mike_platform: action items (short):
1) infra (lee_infra) finalize ingest contract + PR by Fri EOD
2) runtime (kai_eng_runtime) emit v1 to staging with canary tag by Wed
3) product (sara_eng + anna_product) wire dashboard filters and draft rollout UX
4) docs: rollout playbook and rollback criteria (owner?)

sara_eng: I'll own the rollout playbook and canary plan. Will coordinate with @lee_infra and @kai_eng_runtime. I'll also add the cardinality limits and label guidance to the doc.

lee_infra: I'll open the ingest PR today, include tests for label cardinality, and add a compatibility gate so old emitters don't break ingestion. Also will add a small synthetic-data generator for the dashboard devs.

kai_eng_runtime: I'll add emissions to staging by Wed, sampling at 500ms for occupancy and emitting both per-SM arrays and pool aggregates. I'll tag canary=metric-v1.

mike_platform: Q: do we allow per-model labels at the full model-id level? Cardinality risk.

sara_eng: limit to model_family and model_version (coarse). No freeform model ids in labels. We can surface full model ids in a separate low-cardinality logs path if needed.

lee_infra: agreed. schema will specify max cardinality and reject high-cardinality labels.

mike_platform: ok. sync scheduled: Thu 09:00 PT in #eng-platform. Please bring a short status update. :thumbsup:

sara_eng: noted. I'll prepare the playbook template and link it in this thread before Wed.

kai_eng_runtime: noted, will post sample emitter code in staging repo once ready.

lee_infra: ping if you want an early look at the ingest tests.

anna_product: thanks — I'll start mocking dashboard wireframes this afternoon and attach links here. :eyes:

mike_platform: thanks everyone. We'll keep thread for followups.
